messages:
Acme Integrations (Customer): Hey, over the past ~2 hours our app is getting intermittent 5xx and a bunch of client-side timeouts. Saw a huge token billing jump too. 503s then SDK retries spiking calls — possible retry-loop. We can reproduce from our staging region.
Emily (Support): Sorry about that — can you paste a sample request id or the time window? Also which SDK version?
Acme Integrations (Customer): request ids: r-0a1b2c3d, r-0d3c2b1a (approx 2026-03-15T09:02Z to 09:18Z). SDK: js@2.4.1 using the auto-retry default.
Emily (Support): got it. tagging SRE and eng for deeper investigation @Jason (SRE) @Alex (Eng)
Jason (SRE): looking now. any deploys around that time? @Deploy Bot can you show recent deploys for hosted inference gateway?
Deploy Bot: deploys: 
- 2026-03-15T08:55Z - gateway-v1.12.4 -> canary
- 2026-03-15T09:07Z - gateway-v1.12.4 -> prod (rollout)
Jason (SRE): hmm prod rollout at 09:07Z lines up. Checking gateway logs for r-0a1b2c3d...
Alex (Eng): FYI customer reported billing spike — likely retries making more requests on 503s. Could be our retry policy + backpressure on upstream.
Jason (SRE): pulled logs. Root cause appears to be increased queue wait times on the inference pool leading to 504 and upstream translating to 503 on API gateway for streaming requests. Sample excerpt:
```
[09:08:12Z] request r-0a1b2c3d queue_wait_ms=1203 host=gw-12
[09:08:12Z] downstream failure status=RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED
[09:08:12Z] gateway response=503
```
Harry (ML): Were model variants changed during rollout? We had a new quantized variant promoted yesterday but shouldn't affect routing.
Alex (Eng): No variant switches at 09:07; rollout was a gateway config change (backpressure thresholds adjusted).
Emily (Support): Customer — can you share SDK retry config? If retries are aggressive they can amplify load.
Acme Integrations (Customer): default retry (exponential) from js@2.4.1, maxRetries=3, no jitter customization. We assumed SDK would 'do the right thing'.
Jason (SRE): that explains the billing surge — retries x concurrency. For now we're doing two things: 1) temporary mitigation on platform side to reduce queue wait by opening burst capacity for the affected pool, 2) recommend customer lower retry aggressiveness until we confirm stability.
Alex (Eng): I'm rolling a hotfix to gateway backpressure thresholds to favor fast-fail over long queueing. Command I'm applying: 
```bash
# increasing immediate rejection to avoid long queue wait
redwoodctl gateway update --pool infer-prod --backpressure-immediate-reject-ms 300
redwoodctl gateway update --pool infer-prod --max-queue-ms 500
```
Jason (SRE): applied the change at 09:28Z. Monitoring metrics: queue_wait p95 fell from 900ms -> 120ms within 3m.
Deploy Bot: rollout status: gateway-v1.12.4 patch applied to 100% by 09:31Z
Emily (Support): Acme, could you dial the client's maxRetries to 1 temporarily and enable jitter? Example suggestion: 
```js
// suggested temporary retry settings
client.config({ maxRetries: 1, retryDelayBaseMs: 200, jitter: true })
```
Acme Integrations (Customer): will do that now. Also can you confirm we won't be charged for the retry-caused spike? Billing team ping?
Alex (Eng): I can produce a usage/export of the affected window and tag it in a billing ticket. Emily please open a billing escalation referencing this thread and include request ids.
Emily (Support): opened billing ticket #BILL-20260315-437 with exported samples attached. Noted request ids and rollout time.
Harry (ML): Additional note: some requests attempted streaming responses which hold connections longer. The gateway long-queue + streaming can amplify timeouts. If possible switch to non-streaming or reduce max tokens as a temporary reprieve.
Acme Integrations (Customer): switching to non-streaming helped lower latency immediately in staging. But production traffic still heavy.
Jason (SRE): We're watching error rates and latency. After the backpressure change error rate dropped from 6% -> 0.8% over 20m. No new 502/503 spikes in the last 10m.
Emily (Support): I'll keep the customer updated. Customer requested an incident postmortem and confirmation of billing adjustments.
Alex (Eng): We'll prepare a short postmortem: root cause = gateway backpressure threshold change during canary->prod rollout causing long queueing + streaming requests -> resource exhaustion -> 503s; exacerbated by aggressive client retries. Action items:
- Revert backpressure thresholds to safer defaults and add canary gating (Alex)
- Add automatic circuit-breaker on SDK side to avoid synchronized retries (Eng SDK team)
- Billing review and potential credit for retry spike (Support/Billing)
- Improve deploy runbook to monitor queue_wait p95 during gateway rollouts (SRE)
Jason (SRE): I'll own runbook items and add an alert for queue_wait p95 > 500ms during rollouts.
Emily (Support): Customer — we estimate full stabilization and follow-up PM at 15:00Z today. Any immediate questions?
Acme Integrations (Customer): appreciate the rapid response. Please include recommendations for SDK retry defaults. We'll keep maxRetries=1 for now. Also asking for a log of our affected request ids and a billing contact.
Emily (Support): acknowledged. Billing ticket created and I've attached the CSV of requests. Will update once billing team responds.
Alex (Eng): Closing the loop: we've scheduled a postmortem doc and a short changelog entry for the rollback + hotfix. Will share once ready. :thumbsup:
Acme Integrations (Customer): thanks everyone.
